howToPlay: Use the Super to cover the battlefield in fuel and ignite it to control key areas. Manage the fuel gauge carefully by utilizing the Scorchin Siphon star power to reload while dealing damage. Deploy the Fire Starters gadget to create extra oil or use Dancing Flames to defend against close-range threats.
gears: Equip the RELOAD SPEED gear to keep the fire-breathing active longer, and choose the DAMAGE gear to boost the effectiveness of the flames during combat.
trait: This brawler suits players who prefer tactical area control and strategic fire management to zone out enemies.
